profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Qualcomm
profile.summary: Software Engineer at Qualcomm working on the IP Multimedia Subystem team on the modem side. I have a background in robotics, ML, and networking, but I'm always willing to learn more.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: Worked as a backend engineer for Qualcomm's Big Data Server team: I specialize in building and optimizing big data collection pipelines, processing and analyzing hundreds of gigabytes of data. I developed a custom Python solution to decode proto files and efficiently store the data in relational databases. For reporting and data visualization, I implemented aggregation logic and used Grafana to deliver insights. My technical expertise includes MySQL, Java Spring, Kafka, Python, and Grafana, enabling me to streamline data workflows and support data-driven decision-making.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Interned on the Data Connectivity team designing and developing a template class that would follow the Hierarchical State Machine design pattern. The class was developed using C++

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
o Interned as a software engineer on the Digital Transceiver RF Front End team developing C# software used to preprocess and generate modem software.
o Created processing scripts that auto generated embedded C code for the new Qualcomm modems. Additional tasks included optimizing established legacy code as well as implementing a reconciliation program that would auto generate the legacy code for the 3 different variants of the Qualcomm modem.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Interning as a software engineer on the RF tools team and helped develop driver support for a wide range of spectrum analyzers, power supplies, and wireless communication testers. The drivers were developed using the C# language and interface with SCPI commands.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: I operated advanced machinery including: X-ray Diffractometer, SQUID Magnometer, Arc Melter, and Thermogrametric Analyzer and learned lab safety protocol as well as appropriate lab decorum

projects.title: Acoustic Phase Array
projects.description: Design and implemented an 19 speaker array that was capable of focusing sound to within a specified focal diameter. The design consisted of a MATLAB code that generated projected acoustic intensity, and a circuit design that consisted of a power amplification and timing delay stage.

projects.title: MIDI Drumming Glove
projects.description: My partner and I made a glove that can be used as a MIDI device. Each fingertip was equipped with a small phototransistor. After programming an Arduino to convert the serial data to MIDI data, a synthesizer software was able to play a different note for each finger.

organizations.name: Mission Viejo HS Model United Nations
organizations.position: Under-Secretary General of the Novice Conference · Jun 2011 - Jun 2012
organizations.description: I was in charge of running and organizing Mission Viejo High Schools' Model United Nations Novice conference. A conference that was attended by approximately 500 high school students.
